exposure: frequency of sexual activity (too much or too little)
duration of physical contact and sexual foreplay
cohort: The study included 217 Korean women who visited a community-based gynecology hospital for sexual dysfunction.
finding: A diagnosis of HSDD was more common in women in their 40s and those with a history of wide vaginal surgery, while both too much or too little sexual activity caused HSDD, and longer physical contact and sexual foreplay duration lessened its prevalence.
